title: Small stiff laundry bag
text:
Small stiff laundry bag. This laundry “basket” is really more of a stiff bag. It feels somewhat flimsy and will fold on itself/cave in when you put things in it at times. It’s taken us a little getting used to over the past week we have had it. It’s sort of like a tote bag as it isn’t very deep.

I do like the color and pattern on it and it will definitely be used, I just don’t love it like I had hoped I would. I’m hoping it will be more durable than it feels.
